CPV.note: Nothing stated on civil-service digital-skills training.
Says the Tech Park has three data centres but not that any rents to others.
Mentions spaces for digital skills training only in passing; no programme, count or measured share.
Three data centres named at the Tech Park, with no statement of hire, ownership or tier.

facts.fact: Cabo Verde's UGPE is preparing a programme and strategy to attract and retain international startups, with expressions of interest open until 18 February 2025, under the AfDB-financed Technology Park Phase II project.

The Cabo Verde Tech Park is said to already have three data centres, a business centre and spaces for entrepreneurship and digital skills training, with its operationalisation part of the programme; no incubation programme is described.
